served_mismatch: The served HR 0.85 (95% CI 0.53–1.36) describes the primary composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, not all-cause mortality. Registry result outcome 2 reports all-cause mortality HR 1.77 (95% CI 0.81–3.87) in all randomized participants.

candidate_rejections.span: The primary endpoint was a composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for HF. The primary endpoint occurred in 29.7% of patients in the eplerenone group vs. 32.7% in the placebo group [hazard ratio=0.85 (95% CI: 0.53-1.36)].
candidate_rejections.why: Wrong endpoint: cardiovascular death or HF hospitalization composite, rather than all-cause mortality.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The abstract identifies HFrEF entry patients; registry eligibility specifies adults aged at least 55 years. The mortality analysis includes all randomized participants.
